about: The Introit of the formulary “Nativity of the Lord — Mass during the Day” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: A Child is born to us, and a Son is given to us, whose government is upon His shoulder, and His name shall be called the Angel of great counsel. Sing to the Lord a new canticle, for He has done wondrous things. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, for ever and ever. Amen. A Child is born to us, and a Son is given to us, whose government is upon His shoulder, and His name shall be called the Angel of great counsel.
